onboarding.welcome:
Spill the tea.
Read the Bible.
onboarding.q1Title:
How much of the Bible
have you read?
onboarding.q1Comment1: Perfect — Bible Tea makes it easy to jump in. No prior knowledge needed, just press play.
onboarding.q1Comment2: Great start! You'll hear those stories in a way that hits completely different.
onboarding.q1Comment3: You've got a great foundation. Bible Tea brings fresh perspectives you haven't heard before.
onboarding.q1Comment4: Impressive! You'll love how our narrators bring these stories to life with a modern twist.
onboarding.q2Title:
What brings you to
Bible Tea?
onboarding.q2Comment1: You're in the right place — short audio stories you can listen to anytime, anywhere.
onboarding.q2Comment2: We've got deep dives on everyone from Moses to Mary. You'll meet them like never before.
onboarding.q2Comment3: One story a day. Track your streak, build consistency, grow your understanding.
onboarding.q2Comment4: Bible Tea is a judgment-free zone. Explore at your own pace, on your own terms.
onboarding.q2Comment5: Curiosity is the best starting point. Let's show you what Bible Tea is all about.
onboarding.feature1:
Hear the Bible like
you've never heard it
onboarding.feature2:
Every story, every hero —
all in one place
onboarding.feature3:
Scripture that actually
speaks your language
onboarding.reviewsTitle: Don't just take our word for it
onboarding.review1: I never thought I'd binge Bible stories on my commute. This app changed that.
onboarding.review2: The narrators actually make you feel like you're IN the story. Obsessed.
onboarding.rateReview: I put this on during my morning walk and honestly forgot I was learning scripture. It just flows.
